name: Angulotl Blade
manner: Found in freshwater swamps, rivers, and rainforests, angulotls are diminutive, brightly colored amphibious humanoids. Rather than defending their settlements and breeding grounds against hostile creatures, these pacifists turn to magic to establish their homes in places that are nigh-impossible for other humanoids to find. Angulotls are poisonous creatures which suits their preference to avoid aggression—they don't need to be! The contact toxin secreted by their skin gives them defensive protection when threatened, allowing toxin into more potent forms for coating blades and tipping darts.

lore.description: This river water taste funny to you, Sir Rogar?
lore.source: Maximolica, Deceased Squire of Sir Rogar
lore.physiology: Angulotl physiology is delicately balanced, they can't take much in the way of upset. A little toxins don't kill them, they are still affected by pollutants in their waters. Over-contamination of their environments with corrupt angulotls, making them aggressive, confused, and angry. Many corrupted angulotls eventually attack any creature who crosses their path—even other angulotls! Runoff from civilization and mutations seems to infect the most...and sometimes gives them strange abilities.
lore.ecology: Angulotls are happy to hide and watch a gaggle of armed adventurers stumble past the entrance to an angulotl clutch without realizing it. Though angulotls prefer to avoid combat, when they are threatened or enraged they turn deadly.

species.indicator: Angulotl physiology is delicately balanced, they can't take much in the way of upset. A little toxins don't kill them, they are still affected by pollutants in their waters.
species.moisture: Angulotl need to breathe through their skin, but they need to stay damp or they suffocate. They often exude their own dry areas, and they prefer to never stray far from a source of freshwater...unless it's raining.

lore.clawfish: Known as a lotl-ansal (law-OOK-and-shawl), no angulotls, the clawfish resembles a moray eel with eight reptilian legs. These small creatures can slither through the water at blinding up trees nearly as well as they glide through river currents. Angulotls train them not only to pull rafts, but to cleverly fight by choking or electrocuting foes.

actions.name: Machete
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
actions.advantageCondition: If the blade jumped at least 10 feet straight toward the target using Wild Hop on the same turn

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Wild Hop
actions.description: The blade jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed. If the blade uses this bonus action to jump at least 10 feet straight toward a creature, the next Machete attack the blade makes against that creature on the same turn is made with advantage.

traits.title: Amphibious
traits.description: The blade can breathe air and water.

traits.title: Slippery
traits.description: Opportunity attacks against the blade are made with disadvantage.

traits.title: Toxiferous
traits.description: When a creature hits the blade with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the blade, that creature takes 2 (1d4) poison damage.
traits.traitTrigger: When hit by melee attack within 5 feet or touched
